To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the heat-soluble dehydration-induced proteins isolated from dry, maturing wheat embryos can be used to enhance the survival and function of turkey sperm after 24 h in vitro storage.
the addition of a partially purified protein extract from wheat seeds to semen diluent improves sperm survival during in vitro storage.
dehydration-induced proteins from dry, mature, wheat seed embryos can be used to protect turkey sperm from the deleterious effects of in vitro storage.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the mechanisms involved in the protection of the cell membrane during desiccation and the role of dehydration-induced proteins (DIP) during rehydration.
the study of the influence of dehydration-induced proteins on turkey spermatozoal function after in vitro storage.
the development of a method of preserving turkey sperm for long-term storage.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the addition of wheat protein extract to turkey sperm improves survival and function after storage.
the heat-soluble wheat proteins were able to improve the survival and function of turkey sperm stored in vitro for 24 h at refrigeration temperature.
the wheat dehydration-induced proteins are effective in protecting the sperm during the in vitro storage.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the wheat protein extract was able to improve the fertility and hatchability when turkey semen was stored in vitro.
the addition of 10 percent of the wheat protein extract to the diluent of turkey semen stored 24 hours at 5 degrees C improved fertility and hatching rate of eggs over semen in diluent alone.
wheat dehydration-induced proteins can be used as an effective osmo-protectant for turkey sperm and other spermatozoa.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of 10 % wheat embryo proteins to the diluent of stored turkey semen improves fertility and hatchability.
wheat seed proteins are capable of protecting spermatozoa during in vitro storage.
dehydration-induced proteins from plants are capable of improving sperm survival and function during in vitro storage.
